title: The evaluate word's reserve counts interior control characters and its exhausted-shedding path returns only a measured receipt
outcome: The evaluate word's reserve counts interior control characters and its exhausted-shedding path returns only a measured receipt
acceptance: EVALUATE_WORD_RESERVE's derivation counts every word-only text field that may carry interior control characters (the summary title and, where its admission rule allows them, the session id) at six JSON bytes per byte, the maximal-envelope test builds those fields from U+0001 bytes at their admitted maxima, and the reserve covers the derived total with margin

after verdict rows, reminders, and extra next commands are shed, the evaluate word never returns a receipt that agent_receipt_fits rejected: the last resort is a minimal measured receipt that keeps the verdict-independent provenance (evaluation hash, replayed flag, mode, counts, work ref, full detail), whose size a test pins under the budget, with no post-commit refusal path

completion.summary: EVALUATE_WORD_RESERVE is 3072 with its derivation corrected on the constant: the summary title and the effective session id, which admit interior control characters, are counted at six JSON bytes per byte, and the maximal-envelope test builds both from U+0001 bytes at their admitted maxima. The word's exhausted-shedding branch answers with minimal_evaluate_receipt (verdict-independent provenance only), measured like every receipt and pinned under 1 KiB with a control-character session handle; no post-commit refusal path.
